label: Parallel Coordinates with Colour Scale
description: One line per batch across five measurements and a grade axis, coloured by quality score with a draggable range filter.
howTo: Bind `series[0].data` to one row per batch with a value for every axis, in the order of `parallelAxis` (`dim` is the column index).
Each axis has its own `name`, range (`min` / `max`) and may be a category axis (`type: "category"` with `data`), like the grade here.
Colour follows column 4 through `visualMap.dimension`; set `min` / `max` to that column’s range. Dragging the handles hides lines outside the range.
Users can also drag along any axis to brush a range; lines outside it fade (`inactiveOpacity`).
